what: The camera looks around inside an equirectangular (2:1) panorama sphere (radius 500). When released for 1.2s it auto-rotates at 3° per second, and the vertical angle returns to level (0°) at 1.2 shares per second. Dragging turns .1° per 1px (touch ×2.4, drag starts after 6px), and the wheel changes the field of view by delta×.04 within 55–95°. The camera follows the target angle at dt×6 each frame, so it glides to a stop after release. A 110×240 scene light panel (angular grain 17 and 11 flowing at .25 and .18) sits in the light direction, and 220 dust motes within radius 180 fall at .9×(.6–1.1) per second, visible only as much as they align with the light direction (12th power).

options.lon · lat · fov: Initial viewing direction (deg) · field of view, default 273 · 12 · 75
options.idle: Time until it spins on its own after letting go (ms), default 1200
options.drag · touch: Degrees per 1px of drag, default .1 · touch multiplier 2.4
options.wheel: zoom (default — field of view by wheel) or off (use when placed where the page scrolls)
options.zoom · fov-min · fov-max: Field of view per wheel delta · range, default .04 · 55 · 95
options.follow · settle: Share that follows the target (×dt), default 6 · share at which top and bottom return to level 1.2
options.rays · dust: God-ray light strength (0 for none) default .9 · dust count default 220
options.[data-fx-part=map]: Equirectangular image to wrap on the sphere Or (After the canvas is repainted, sending fx:map makes it read again) — if absent, a column pattern in the skin color
options.[data-fx-part=pin]: HTML marker that follows the data-lon·data-lat direction (hidden when on the far side)
options.fx:look: {lon, lat, fov, rate, turn, hold} Sending a direction turns toward it and changes the field of view at rate (default 1.6)/s — if you pass turn, the target direction itself approaches by turn×dt each step so it turns slowly (2.2 when heading to the original’s door), and hold: true stops it from turning on its own

from.where: index.html .cs-pano (cathedral panorama hero) — original MainScene: autoRotateSpeed 3 · 1200ms · drag .1 · wheel .04 · FOV 55~95 · dust 220 · god-ray plane

note: Load the three global (THREE) first (take library/_vendor/three@0.184.0/build/three.cjs through window.exports as THREE). Wheel zoom hijacks the wheel, so use it only on Heroes that fill the full screen height and on app-style panels — when placing it mid scroll page, use wheel: off
